dedupe_keys.name: experimental evaluation and coordinated deployment of ramp rate limitation against rapid voltage changes in distribution systems

description: The source evaluates storage-supported ramp-rate limitation in a scaled CIGRE medium-voltage laboratory feeder and develops a system-level allocation strategy to suppress rapid voltage changes while minimising participating converters and storage requirements. The strategy is tested with dynamic RMS simulation of the IEEE European low-voltage feeder. This coordinated allocation model is distinct from the earlier comparison of three established smoothing methods.
